name: Luxury RV Resort
description: Luxury RV Resort in Gulf Shores, Alabama is a beautiful coastal campground featuring 97 full-hookup RV sites and vacation rental units, all within walking distance to the renowned beaches of Gulf Shores and Orange Beach. The resort offers both 30 and 50 amp electrical service with concrete pads, water, sewer, and cable hookups at every site. Whether you want to enjoy the beach, find adventure in town, or simply relax by the pool, Luxury RV Resort has what you're looking for. The Alabama Coastal area is beloved and well known for its picturesque white sand shores, unique outdoor adventures, award-winning coastal cuisine, and a variety of local tourist spots. Winter is a special time with many Snowbird visitors that return year after year for the community, variety of activities, and unique coastal Alabama camping experience.
